title: A strict henselization triple has the same strict henselization
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal m and separable residue-field closure K, let C be the strict henselization of R obtained from the filtered category of pointed etale R-algebra triples (S,q,phi) with q over m and residue embedding into K [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For every such triple, put A=S_q and let A^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to the induced embedding of its residue field into K. Then there is a canonical isomorphism A^{\mathrm{sh}}\cong C compatible with S\to A\to A^{\mathrm{sh}} and S\to C; under it qA^{\mathrm{sh}} identifies with the maximal ideal mC, and the qA^{\mathrm{sh}}-adic completion identifies with \varprojlim_n C/(mC)^n [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion].
